decision: Use discrete-event simulation with a factorial scenario grid and 30 declared seeds per cell; preserve each run manifest and sensitivity result.
credible_alternatives: Closed-form approximation only; rejected because burst and queue interactions violate the simplifying assumptions in high-load cases.
criteria: Route fit; evidence production; feasibility; ethics/rights; reversibility
evidence_and_authority: Token-bucket versus fixed-window, checked against hand-calculated limiting cases and a no-control reference.
assumptions_and_risks: Monte Carlo variation, sensitivity to arrival and service assumptions, implementation error and scenario-selection bias.
conditional_commitment: Use discrete-event simulation with a factorial scenario grid and 30 declared seeds per cell; preserve each run manifest and sensitivity result.
early_test: Verify empty-load, saturated-load and deterministic-service cases against hand-calculated expectations before running the full grid.
reopening_trigger: A failed limiting-case check reopens Execution Gate; an assumption unsupported by the intended context reopens Design Gate.
